title.narrative: strengthening the measuring and monitoring of SDG 16 in conflict and fragility affected countries

description.narrative: The proposal will support the implementation of the SDG16 Survey, an international survey instrument jointly developed by UNDP, UNODC and OHCHR in collaboration with member states, that countries can use to measure progress on many of the survey-based indicators under SDG16. The proposal will support four countries to implement specific survey modules based on national needs and priorities which can be attached to household surveys primarily conducted by National Statistics Offices (NSOs). A core objective of this proposal is to strengthen gender-disaggregated data. The SDG 16 Survey is designed to be adaptable, allowing implementation as a stand-alone survey or as modular additions to existing nationally representative population surveys, depending on national priorities and needs. Each module represents a thematic coverage, namely: access to justice, corruption, discrimination, governance, violence and trafficking in persons. The SDG 16 Survey, although an international tool, is designed to be adapted to each country’s unique context, allowing it to reflect local realities while the data still being comparable across countries.

condition.narrative: Social and environmental sustainability will be enhanced through application of the UNDP Social and Environmental Standards (http://www.undp.org/ses) and related Accountability Mechanism (http://www.undp.org/secu-srm).
